EmailTemplate.name: MQL Qualified Lead not in SAL
EmailTemplate.subject: MQL is not claimed by Sales.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} has been Qualified and assigned to you.
Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
As a reminder, the following SLA’s are expected for any MQL lead: If a Lead has been Qualified and Reassigned to you, you must either 'Claim' the Lead to move the Stage to SAL or disposition the Lead if you are not pursuing. This should be completed within 3 days of assignment.
Leads move to a terminated state if there is no activity for 30 days and 90 days since the creation date.
Thank you.
